Name: Oh So Cute Kitchen
Author: katestardew
Description:
[left]﻿[size=5][b][color=#ff0000]DISCLAIMER: [/color]For the time being, I have decided to post this mod to NexusMods only. [color=#ffff00]Please DO NOT repost my mod nor download this from other sites.[/color] [color=#00ff00]Please respect that[/color]. Thank you.[/b][/size][/left]

[size=3][b]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b][/size]

﻿﻿[color=#f4cccc][b][font=Courier New][size=5][center]˗ˏˋ ♡ about the mod ♡ ˎˊ˗[/center][/size][/font][/b][/color][font=Arial][size=3]
hello! it's been a while again and i'm back again for a new mod upload ٩(ˊᗜˋ*)و this time, i released [i][color=#ead1dc]Oh So Cute! Kitchen [/color][/i]which is a kitchen mod made to match my Casual Furniture Set ! it's made of my usual choice of soft colors and cute designs. i've always wanted to make one since i feel like it's empty to use my furniture mod without the kitchen i think would go along with it (+ with other furniture sets as well) ₊˚.༄

[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]✧ the kitchen mod is a [b][u]full set[/u][/b] [/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]➯ this includes both the kitchen and the kitchen island, available in Content Patcher (CP) mod altogether

✧ HOWEVER you may get kitchen and kitchen island separately just in case you do not have enough space in your furniture assets anymore ( ˶ˆ꒳ˆ˵ ) the kitchen alone in CP,,,, then the kitchen island available in both Custom Furniture (CF) and Alternative Textures (AT)

✧ possible updates may happen ! i might be able to modify some stuff or add new things (ps: maybe different kitchen arrangement/designs)



[/size][/font][center]﻿﻿[color=#f4cccc][b][font=Courier New][size=5]˗ˏˋ ♡ key features ♡ ˎˊ˗[/size][/font][/b][/color][/center]
[font=Arial][size=3]✧ the kitchen alone has A LOT of stuff ! you can find the refrigerator with sticky notes, a sink with pink rug, a white gas range, chopping board with vegetables, pink glass bottle, a frying pan with an egg, rice cooker, MANY pink and white cabinet with sticky notes + other designs, pepper and salt shakers, colored cups, jar with coffee beans, and a potted plant . . .

✧ the kitchen island ALSO has a lot of items on top ! white carnations, a slice of strawberry shortcake on a metal tray, a mini pink oven, a coffee cup, a pair of silver scissors, a cookbook, and some sticky notes + a small rug peeking out of the gray wooden drawer . . .

✧ i have also made a small version of the kitchen for ginger island ! a white gas range with a different design, the sink with a pink rug, and the pink refrigerator with a potted plant on top [/size][/font]


[color=#f4cccc]

[size=5][font=Courier New][b][center]˗ˏˋ ♡ instructions ♡ ˎˊ˗[/center][/b][/font][/size]
[/color][font=Arial][size=3]✧ you must have downloaded[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ [/b]before you can ever use mods. get that first !
✧ if you plan on using the Content Patcher (CP) version of the mod, you must have downloaded both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [color=#ead1dc]CP - Oh So Kitchen[/color]. Then, put both files in your Mods folder. Enjoy! ( ˊᵕˋ )[/size][/font]





[center][b][size=4]BUT !!!![/size] [size=3]if you plan on using both kitchen and kitchen island [/size][/b][size=3][u][i][b]separately[/b][/i][/u][b], do the following:[/b][/size][/center]
[list=1]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]again, you must have SMAPI.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]download Content Patcher and [color=#ead1dc]CP - Oh So Cute! Kitchen (Solo)[/color]. Put both files in your Mods folder.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Arial][size=3]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]if you want to download the Custom Furniture (CF) version of the kitchen island, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]﻿ and [color=#b6d7a8]CF - Oh So Cute! Kitchen Island[/color]. Put both files in your Mods folder.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Arial][size=3]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]if you want to download the Alternative Textures (AT) version of the kitchen island, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ and [color=#b6d7a8]AT - Oh So Cute! Kitchen Island[/color]. Put both files in your Mods folder. Buy the Paint Bucket from Robin. Get the Festive Dining Table furniture, equip the Pain Bucket tool from your bag and click on the furniture to get the kitchen island [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Arial]
[/font]




[font=Courier New][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b][center]˗ˏˋ ♡ closing ♡ ˎˊ˗[/center][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]if you have any questions, pls kindly ask me in the comment section. i'll try my best to answer them ![/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]if there are any errors or bugs, pls kindly tell me in the comment section as well so i can fix it as soon as possible.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Arial][size=3]


[center][b][color=#f4cccc]thank you very much ! hope you enjoy (*๓´╰╯`๓)[/color][/b][/center][/size][/font][font=Arial]



[/font]
